subject.title: [Feature]:  Non-blocking heartbeat execution to prevent message processing delays

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a separate non-blocking heartbeat execution lane or worker, and what session, delivery, and tool-state isolation contract should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix changes core heartbeat execution semantics and could affect session ordering, message delivery, tool side effects, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Design A Heartbeat Isolation Lane
options.body: Define and implement a separate heartbeat execution model with explicit session, delivery, busy-state, and tool-side-effect boundaries before changing runtime behavior.

options.title: Limit To Existing Mitigations
options.body: Keep the current awaited heartbeat turn and improve narrower mitigations such as retry cadence, idle timeout, tool policy, `isolatedSession`, `lightContext`, and timeout behavior through their canonical issues.

options.title: Decline A Core Execution Change
options.body: Close the direction after deciding the current heartbeat primitives are sufficient and that more isolation should come from configuration or plugins rather than core runtime changes.

recommendation.title: Design A Heartbeat Isolation Lane
recommendation.body: Define and implement a separate heartbeat execution model with explicit session, delivery, busy-state, and tool-side-effect boundaries before changing runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent heartbeat runner, wake, docs, and product-review history in the inspected evidence.
